learnerProfile.target: 好了，你的底牌我都摸清了！你的最终学习目标是：**从基础API调用起步，使用Python结合Function Calling技术，开发一个能在隔离Docker容器内自主读取代码、执行测试并修复Bug的SWE Agent。** 准备好开始爆肝了吗？
learnerProfile.summary: 好家伙，基础Python刚上手、数据结构还停留在"听说过"的阶段，就敢直奔Function Calling + Docker隔离容器 + 自主修Bug的SWE Agent——这野心我太喜欢了！你是个典型的"项目驱动型冒险家"，比起啃理论你更愿意在真实代码里摸爬滚打，这恰恰是做Agent开发最对路的气质。每周2-5小时、5-8周的节奏说紧凑也紧凑，但只要咱们把Function Calling当主轴、Docker当沙盒、测试反馈当指南针，这条路完全跑得通。别担心底子薄，你缺的不是能力而是地图，而这张地图——我已经给你画好了。欢迎入坑，未来的SWE Agent架构师，咱们开工吧！🔥

units.title: 驯服Python野马 — 从基础语法到文件与JSON的急速冲刺
units.description: 在让你的AI Agent去读代码、跑测试之前，它得先学会"说Python"。本单元是你整条学习路线的地基：文件读写让Agent能打开源码文件，JSON解析让Agent能消化OpenAI API的返回结果，异常处理让Agent在遇到崩溃时不至于当场去世。每一块知识都是最终SWE Agent项目的拼图——没有这些，你的Agent连一个bug report都读不懂。准备好用5小时从Python新手进化到"能写工具函数的冒险者"了吗？🔥
objectives: Use Python lists, dicts, sets, and tuples to organize and manipulate structured data
Read from and write to files using Python's open() function and context managers (with statement)
Parse and generate JSON data using the json module (json.loads, json.dumps, json.load, json.dump)
Define and call Python functions with default arguments, *args, and **kwargs
Handle exceptions using try/except/finally blocks and raise custom error messages

units.title: 唤醒AI的大脑 — OpenAI API与Function Calling初体验
units.description: 你的SWE Agent需要一个能思考、能决策的"大脑"。本单元教你调用OpenAI的Chat Completions API，并掌握Function Calling——让大模型自主决定该调用哪个工具（读文件？跑测试？改代码？）。这正是你最终项目中Agent做出"下一步该干什么"决策的核心机制。学完本单元，你就拥有了一个能根据指令自动选择并调用Python函数的AI助手，这是SWE Agent的神经中枢。
prerequisites: Parse and generate JSON data using the json module (json.loads, json.dumps, json.load, json.dump)
Define and call Python functions with default arguments, *args, and **kwargs
Handle exceptions using try/except/finally blocks and raise custom error messages
objectives: Call the OpenAI Chat Completions API using the openai Python SDK and parse the text response from the JSON result
Define function/tool schemas in JSON format with name, description, and parameters and pass them to the OpenAI API tools parameter
Detect tool_calls in the API response, extract the function name and arguments, and execute the corresponding Python function
Feed function execution results back to the LLM as a tool role message in a multi-turn conversation to continue reasoning
prerequisiteObjectiveIds: Parse and generate JSON data using the json module (json.loads, json.dumps, json.load, json.dump)
Define and call Python functions with default arguments, *args, and **kwargs
Handle exceptions using try/except/finally blocks and raise custom error messages

units.title: 建造数字沙盒 — Docker隔离容器与安全代码执行
units.description: 你的Agent要跑别人写的代码、执行测试——万一那段代码是个炸弹呢？你需要一个"沙盒"。本单元教你用Docker SDK for Python创建隔离容器，在里面安全地执行代码和运行pytest。这正是你最终SWE Agent项目的"双手"：Agent在Docker容器里跑测试、看结果、判断bug是否修好，全程不碰你的宿主机一丝一毫。没有这层隔离，你的Agent就是个裸奔的危险品。
prerequisites: Read from and write to files using Python's open() function and context managers (with statement)
Define and call Python functions with default arguments, *args, and **kwargs
Handle exceptions using try/except/finally blocks and raise custom error messages
objectives: Use the Docker SDK for Python (docker-py) to create, start, stop, and remove containers programmatically
Execute commands inside a Docker container using exec_run and capture stdout and stderr output
Use Python's subprocess module to run shell commands such as pytest and capture their exit code and output text
Write a Dockerfile that sets up a Python environment with dependencies installed for running test suites
prerequisiteObjectiveIds: Read from and write to files using Python's open() function and context managers (with statement)
Define and call Python functions with default arguments, *args, and **kwargs
Handle exceptions using try/except/finally blocks and raise custom error messages

units.title: 缝合怪诞生 — Agent Loop架构与多工具编排
units.description: 大脑（Unit 2的Function Calling）和双手（Unit 3的Docker沙盒）都有了，现在要把它们缝在一起，造出一个能自主行动的Agent。本单元教你实现Agent Loop——那个经典的while-not-done循环：调用LLM → 检查是否有tool_call → 执行工具 → 把结果喂回去 → 重复。这是你最终SWE Agent项目的骨架结构，所有后续的bug修复逻辑都跑在这个循环之上。学完这步，你的Agent已经能"自己想、自己做、自己看结果"了。

Define function/tool schemas in JSON format with name, description, and parameters and pass them to the OpenAI API tools parameter

Register multiple tools (read_file, run_tests, edit_file) as function definitions available to the LLM in a single API call
Parse tool call requests from the LLM response and route each call to the correct handler function using a dispatch dictionary
Implement termination conditions for the agent loop including max iteration limit and a task-complete signal from the LLM

units.title: BugHunter觉醒 — 构建你的自主修Bug SWE Agent
units.description: 🔥时刻到了！这是整条学习路线的终极Boss战。你要把前四个单元的全部技能熔铸成一个完整的SWE Agent：它能接收一个有bug的Python项目，在Docker隔离容器里跑测试，通过Function Calling自主决定读哪个文件、改哪行代码，然后重新跑测试验证——循环往复直到bug被消灭。这个项目直接整合了Unit 1的文件/JSON处理、Unit 2的Function Calling决策、Unit 3的Docker沙盒执行、以及Unit 4的Agent Loop架构。你将亲手创造一个能"看bug、想对策、动手修、验结果"的AI工程师。准备好见证你的Agent第一次自主修好一个bug时的震撼了吗？

Parse tool call requests from the LLM response and route each call to the correct handler function using a dispatch dictionary
Implement termination conditions for the agent loop including max iteration limit and a task-complete signal from the LLM
Detect tool_calls in the API response, extract the function name and arguments, and execute the corresponding Python function

objectives: Build a complete SWE Agent CLI tool that accepts a buggy Python repository path and a failing test command as input arguments
Integrate Docker-based code execution to run pytest inside an isolated container and return structured pass/fail results to the LLM
Use Function Calling to let the LLM autonomously choose between read_file, run_tests, and edit_file tools during the bug-fixing process
Implement a multi-step bug-fixing workflow where the agent iterates through read-test-edit cycles until tests pass or max attempts are reached
Demonstrate the agent successfully fixing at least 2 pre-seeded bugs in a sample Python project with all tests passing

units.title: 锻造钢铁意志 — 健壮性、提示工程与Agent进阶修炼
units.description: 你的BugHunter已经能修bug了，但它还像个刚出道的实习生——API一限流就懵、上下文一长就忘、提示词不够好就乱改代码。本单元是"毕业前的最后一课"：加入重试机制对抗API不稳定，用上下文窗口管理让Agent在长任务中不丢失记忆，用精心设计的System Prompt引导Agent走"读错误→定位bug→假设修复→验证"的科学调试流程，再用结构化日志记录Agent的每一步操作。这些是把你的Agent从"能跑的玩具"变成"靠谱的工具"的关键一跃。
prerequisites: Build a complete SWE Agent CLI tool that accepts a buggy Python repository path and a failing test command as input arguments
Use Function Calling to let the LLM autonomously choose between read_file, run_tests, and edit_file tools during the bug-fixing process
Implement a multi-step bug-fixing workflow where the agent iterates through read-test-edit cycles until tests pass or max attempts are reached
Implement an agent loop using a while-not-done pattern that repeatedly calls the LLM, checks for tool calls, executes them, and feeds results back into the conversation
objectives: Add retry logic with exponential backoff to handle OpenAI API rate limits and transient network failures gracefully
Implement context window management by summarizing or truncating older conversation messages when total token count approaches the model limit
Design a system prompt that guides the LLM through a structured debugging workflow: read error output, locate relevant code, hypothesize a fix, apply edit, and verify with tests
Add structured logging using Python's logging module to record every agent action, tool call, LLM response, and test result for auditing and debugging
